objective: Deterministic, evidence-bound operational continuity across conversation and engineering-worker boundaries

fidelity_contract.operational: Facts, source identifiers, controls, unknowns and action dependencies, to the extent supplied in validated input
fidelity_contract.evidence_archive: Operational continuity plus copied and hashed source-evidence bytes declared in raw_sources
fidelity_contract.verbatim_conversation: NOT_ATTESTED: complete raw chat export, omitted tool data and source completeness cannot be inferred from summaries
fidelity_contract.integrity_vs_authenticity: SHA-256 detects byte changes relative to a trusted root, but an independently trusted signature or anchor would be required for authenticity

stages.exit: Input is a dated observation, not a live-authority claim
No fabricated UNKNOWN counts, source SHA mismatch, unsupported PASS or unauthorized merge
Every measured claim has traceable source-bound evidence
Comparisons only accepted with identical verified instrumentor, scope, paths, method and configuration
No authority inferred; first-red remains explicit; action dependencies acyclic
All outputs generated solely from declared inputs without network/time randomness
All files hashed and manifest root committed; no self-hash recursion
Independent byte-for-byte regeneration equals all files; unmanifested files rejected
Consumer refreshes live exact head, statuses and approval instead of trusting stale facts
Forward change is measured under verified identical comparison basis

admission_policy: Engineering progress can continue independently. Merge and promotion are fail-closed on exact-head CI, full security, branch protection, independent review, and authorized decision.
stop_conditions: No execution authority and no complete checkout
Unverified confidentiality of included raw files
known_non_goals: Full transcript reconstruction from a summary
Using artifacts from another SHA as exact-head proof
Remote provider authentication solely from URLs
